{"metadata":{"description":"Manage DeepSeek Harness locally: run multiple DSH versions in isolated containers, open the UI in an embedded WebView, import plugins/skills with one click, share extension bundles, and let a queued task system handle installs with live logs. Zero-dependency installer.","id":"gh:1333708301","install_available":false,"language":"Rust","name":"DSHBox","slug":"Nexus-Aethra/DSHBox","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Manage DeepSeek Harness locally: run multiple DSH versions in isolated containers, open the UI in an"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" embedded WebView, import plugins/skills with one click, share extension bundles, and let a queued t"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ask system handle installs with live logs. Zero-dependency installer."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Box"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Managed DeepSeek Harness desktop runtime** — run, isolate, and extend multiple DeepSeek Harness en"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"vironments on your own machine, no browser tab required."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DSH Box is a lightweight desktop shell built with Tauri 2 that installs, launches, and manages indep"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"endent DSH **Containers** — each with its own DSH version, profile, plugins, skills, workspace, and "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"logs — and renders them in an embedded WebView."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Isolated containers** — one DSH version, profile, workspace and host process each.
- **Optional "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"VM runtime (experimental)** — a container may declare `runtime: "vm"` / `"vm:<backend>"`; host mode "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"stays the default. Windows uses one WSL2 distro per container, Linux a libkrun microVM. See the runt"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ime design note.
- **Embedded WebView** — the DSH UI opens in a native window; no ports, no URLs to "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"paste.
- **Ready in seconds** — a pulled Harness version arrives with its client artifacts built; `r"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"un` is a copy (~10s).
- **Plugin dependency graph** — what loads, in what order, why: depth bands, h"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"alves apart, fold a depth away.
- **Resources: extract, inject, edit** — conversations, keys and plu"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"gin state as named copies; any YAML block editable by key path.
- **An agent surface** — `dshbox app"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"ly -f` configures resources from one document; every verb answers `--json`.
- **An agent inside a co"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"ntainer** — the `dsh-box-sandbox` plugin gives an agent running inside a container typed `box_*` too"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"ls, so it drives the box that contains it with no shell and nothing to install.
- **Zero-dependency "},{"id":"p7s12","text":"install** — bundled Node, npm, pnpm and Git (Windows), in a clean room.
- **Version manager** — inst"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"all any Harness tag and pin a version per container.
- **Boxfiles** — `FROM` + `ADD` describes a tem"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"plate; build once, run many.
- **Portable templates** — every payload is materialised into the templ"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"ate, so containers depend on nothing mutable.
- **Bundles** — group plugins and skills, then export "},{"id":"p7s16","text":"quick (URLs kept) or full (one archive).
- **Tasks you can watch** — every task declares its stages "},{"id":"p7s17","text":"up front, and each stage carries its own bar, its elapsed time and its budget, so a step that is tak"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"ing minutes looks different from one that has hung. Cancellable, logged, with history.
- **A slow da"},{"id":"p7s19","text":"emon never freezes the window** — commands run off the main thread and every RPC is bounded.
- **An "},{"id":"p7s20","text":"older server is kept, and said so** — a service from a previous build keeps running, with a topbar l"},{"id":"p7s21","text":"ine naming both.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Download the installer for your platform from the **Releases** page of this repository:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Platform | Artifact | Notes |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Windows (x64) | `dshbox_<version>_x64_<locale>.msi` | MSI installer with bundled runtime and sidec"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ar |
| Linux (x64) | `dshbox-<version>-amd64.deb` | Debian/Ubuntu package |
| macOS (arm64) | `dshbo"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"x-<version>-arm64.dmg` | Apple Silicon |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> Grab the latest version from the Releases page — artifact names follow the `<product>-<version>-<a"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"rch>` convention. Every tagged release carries all three platforms, built by the release workflow."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"No runtime prerequisites on Windows — the bundled Node/npm/pnpm/Git runtime travels inside the insta"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ller. Linux needs a system Git (`apt install git` or your distro equivalent); its configuration is i"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"solated per-runtime-directory, so your host `~/.gitconfig` is never read by DSH Box builds."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. **Launch DSH Box** and pick a writable *runtime directory* when prompted (all DSH data lives ther"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e).
2. Open **Resources** → **DSH Versions** → **Load versions**, then install the DSH tag you want."},{"id":"p15s3","text":"
3. Open **Resources** → **Templates**, then pull an official DSH template or build a reusable templ"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ate from a Boxfile.
4. Open **Container** → create a Container from that template (name and profile)"},{"id":"p15s5","text":".
5. The first create prepares the Container in its final directory (offline dependency install, loc"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"al plugins, frontend build). Press **Start** — DSH Box launches that prepared copy and opens the DSH"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" UI in the embedded WebView.
6. Use **Resources** to import plugins/skills, assemble bundles, or cre"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ate Boxfiles for reusable plugin-enabled templates."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Tray"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The app minimizes to the system tray on close. Use the tray menu to open the window or start/stop/re"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"start the `dshboxd` background service."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### When the server is from an older build"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The box is a background service, so it often outlives the app that installed
it. After you install a"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" newer DSH Box while the previous one is still running,
the two do not match — and the running serve"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"r is **kept**. The RPC only grows,
so the client falls back for anything the older daemon cannot do,"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" and the cost
of stopping it would be a container start or a build you asked for a moment
earlier. A"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" line in the topbar says so, naming both builds, so the difference is
visible instead of something y"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ou have to find in a log file."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Nothing is broken while it is there. Features that need the newer server show up
once you restart th"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e service from the tray menu — at a moment you chose, not one
the app picked for you."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"DSH Box separates a Tauri **desktop shell**, a framework-free Rust workspace, a background **daemon*"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"* (`dshboxd`), and a small React frontend. The split exists so all business logic — plugin fetching,"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" container lifecycle, template resolution, background tasks — is testable without a UI, and so a CLI"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" or external agent can drive the same flows the UI does."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Layered components"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Layer | What lives here | Why |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Frontend (React 18 + Vite, `src/`) | Pages, components, `useTaskQueue`/`useContainers`/`useResourc"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"es`/`useSettings` hooks. **No business logic** — pages fire RPC requests and react to daemon SSE eve"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"nts. | Keeps the Box UI thin and lets any client (UI/CLI/agent) share the same code path. |
| Deskto"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"p shell (Tauri 2, `src-tauri/src/`) | Browser window, tray, Tauri IPC adapters. Listens on `127.0.0."},{"id":"p25s5","text":"1` to the daemon's loopback HTTP server. All real work is delegated to `dshboxd` over HTTP RPC. | On"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"e source of truth for state changes — UI and CLI cannot drift. |
